note: Record counts reported by the data.gov.in service on 25 Nov 2026 for the newest records (lowercase-field index), used to state how complete each download is.
cropsNote: Newest Kamrup records per extra crop, counted the same way. A crop is shown in the web app only when its file data/assam-kamrup-<crop>-2026.jsonl holds this many records.
staplesNote: Newest records for all of Assam (lowercase-field index, from late 2025), counted on 25 Nov 2026. The bulk copy holds no Assam records for paddy, jute or arecanut dated 2023 or later, and 5 for mustard.
